baseline='abe98510ba3ad24276c2af2bd89c80b24209b568'
changed=git('diff','--name-only',baseline).splitlines()
allowed=lambda p:p.startswith(('Documentation/Validation/Issue441/','tools/','UnitTests/TestThermal')) or p in ['Documentation/Architecture/Issue441ThermalReadinessPlan.md','+WVInternal/buildThermalPage.m']
assert all(allowed(p) for p in changed),[p for p in changed if not allowed(p)]
assert not any(p.startswith('tools/free-surface-initialization-study/') for p in changed)
git('diff','--check')
for paths in [('resources/mpackage.json',),('docs','Documentation/WebsiteDocumentation')]:git('diff','--exit-code',baseline,'--',*paths)
manifest=json.loads((repo/'resources/mpackage.json').read_text())
paths=[f['path'] for f in manifest['folders']]
assert 'tools' not in paths and 'UnitTests' not in paths and 'Documentation' not in paths
export=(root/'OceanKit/tools/ci_release.m').read_text()
assert 'options.excluded_dist_folders string = [".git", ".github", "docs", "tools", "Documentation", "OceanKit"]' in export
provenance=json.loads((root/'thermal-readiness-t10-evidence/pinned/provenance.json').read_text())
files=list((repo/'Documentation/Validation/Issue441').rglob('*'))
for p in files:
 if not p.is_file():continue
 assert p.suffix not in ['.mat','.nc'],str(p)
 if p.suffix in ['.md','.csv','.json']:
  data=p.read_bytes();assert b'\r' not in data,str(p)
  assert all(line.rstrip(b' \t')==line for line in data.splitlines()),str(p)
  if p.suffix=='.json':json.loads(data)
result=dict(passed=True,sourceHead=git('rev-parse','HEAD').strip(),baseline=baseline,changedFiles=changed,checkedValidationFiles=sum(p.is_file() for p in files),localLinks="checked separately after final artifact collection",packagePaths=paths,authoringExcludedFromRuntimePath=True,toolsAndDocumentationExcludedFromExport=True,testFilesMayRemainInExport=True,manifestAndGeneratedWebsiteUnchanged=True,unrelatedUntrackedExcluded='tools/free-surface-initialization-study/',scope='Source/repository and linked-artifact checks; scientific results remain in their own ledgers.')
(root/'thermal-readiness-t10-evidence/recovery/final-scope.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

import json, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=base.parent.parent/'wave-vortex-model'
jobs=[('activity-comparison','compareActivity.m',8,900),('diagnostic-regimes','diagnosticRegimes.m',16,900),('budget-cold10','budgetCold10.m',16,900),('budget-cold100','budgetCold100.m',16,900),('budget-peak10','budgetPeak10.m',16,900),('budget-zero10','budgetZero10.m',16,900),('budget-zero100','budgetZero100.m',16,900),('resources','resources.m',8,600),('resources769','resources769.m',8,600),('metadata','metadata.m',8,900),('legacy-forcing-export','exportLegacyForcings.m',16,900),('analyzer-all','analyzerAll.m',8,600)]
recorded=0.0
for result_path in base.rglob('result.json'):
    contract_path=result_path.with_name('contract.json')
    if not contract_path.is_file():continue
    result=json.loads(result_path.read_text());contract=json.loads(contract_path.read_text())
    if '-batch' in contract.get('command',[]):recorded+=result.get('elapsedSeconds',0)
budget=min(3600.0,max(0.0,4*3600-recorded))
started=time.monotonic()
(base/'completion-queue-contract.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(recordedPostRestartMatlabGuardSeconds=recorded,remainingQueueWallSeconds=budget,budgetScope='Post-restart retained elapsed only; unavailable pre-reboot compute is not reconstructed'),indent=2)+'\n')
rows=[]
for name,script,limit,seconds in jobs:
    remaining=int(budget-(time.monotonic()-started))
    if remaining<1:print('STOP completion queue: elapsed budget exhausted',flush=True);break
    seconds=min(seconds,remaining)
    print('START '+name,flush=True)
    command=[sys.executable,str(repo/'tools/guardThermalReadiness.py'),'--directory',str(base/name),'--limit-gib',str(limit),'--seconds',str(seconds),'--','matlab','-batch',"run('"+str(base/script)+"')"]
    status=subprocess.run(command,cwd=repo).returncode
    rows.append(dict(name=name,returncode=status));(base/'completion-queue.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('END '+name+' status='+str(status),flush=True)
    result_path=base/name/'result.json'
    result=json.loads(result_path.read_text()) if result_path.is_file() else {}
    if status in (130,143) or result.get('reason')=='cancelled' or result.get('cancellationSignals'):break

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run one MATLAB batch with macOS footprint and elapsed-time cutoffs.

Uses the SDK's rusage_info_v0 definition. Only signals the child process
session created here. The ledger is flushed after every sample.
"""
import argparse, csv, ctypes, json, os, pathlib, signal, subprocess, sys, time

class Usage(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('uuid',ctypes.c_uint8*16)]+[(n,ctypes.c_uint64) for n in (
        'user_time','system_time','pkg_idle_wkups','interrupt_wkups','pageins',
        'wired_size','resident_size','phys_footprint','proc_start_abstime','proc_exit_abstime')]

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--directory',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--limit-gib',type=float,default=12)
    parser.add_argument('--seconds',type=float,default=1800)
    parser.add_argument('command',nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args=parser.parse_args(); command=args.command
    if command and command[0]=='--': command=command[1:]
    if not command or args.limit_gib<=0 or args.seconds<=0: parser.error('Supply a command and positive limits.')
    out=pathlib.Path(args.directory);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    library=ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libproc.dylib',use_errno=True)
    library.proc_pid_rusage.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p]
    library.proc_pid_rusage.restype=ctypes.c_int
    start=time.monotonic();reason='completed';peak=0; rss_peak=0; successes=0
    with open(out/'output.log','w') as log,open(out/'memory.csv','w') as stream:
        process=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
        writer=csv.writer(stream);writer.writerow(['elapsedSeconds','pid','residentBytes','physicalFootprintBytes']);stream.flush()
        (out/'contract.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=command,pid=process.pid,limitGiB=args.limit_gib,maximumSeconds=args.seconds),indent=2))
        while process.poll() is None:
            elapsed=time.monotonic()-start; info=Usage()
            status=library.proc_pid_rusage(process.pid,0,ctypes.byref(info))
            if status==0:
                successes+=1;peak=max(peak,info.phys_footprint);rss_peak=max(rss_peak,info.resident_size)
                writer.writerow([elapsed,process.pid,info.resident_size,info.phys_footprint]);stream.flush()
            if status!=0 and elapsed>10 and successes==0: reason='measurement-unavailable'
            if info.phys_footprint>args.limit_gib*2**30: reason='memory-limit'
            if elapsed>args.seconds: reason='wall-limit'
            if reason!='completed':
                os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
                try: process.wait(timeout=3)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                break
            time.sleep(.25)
        returncode=process.wait()
    result=dict(reason=reason,returncode=returncode,elapsedSeconds=time.monotonic()-start,peakSampledFootprintBytes=peak,peakSampledResidentBytes=rss_peak,samples=successes,samplingIntervalSeconds=.25)
    (out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    return 0 if reason=='completed' and returncode==0 else 1
if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(main())
